verdict.rationale: Expensify documents a public Integration Server API with generated credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret), secret rotation, and an OAuth2 authorization code flow for acting on behalf of users. That confirms a real, documented programmatic entry point, but the evidence never shows which operations the API exposes, so the extent to which it can drive the product is unproven. The 'Ask Expensify' natural-language feature is an in-app chat capability, not an API, and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint coverage (creating, approving, or exporting expenses and reports), request/response reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
